Let me understand the rule from the verifier.

The input is a 3x3 grid. The verifier:
- x0 = asobject(I) - all cells with values
- x1 = mostcolor(I) - most common color (background, e.g., 0)
- x4 = cells whose color != mostcolor (non-background cells)
- for each such cell, create an object (initset applies to cell -> frozenset of one cell)
- x7 = compose(shoot with UNITY, center) - for each single-cell object, center is that cell, shoot in direction (1,1) -> diagonal line down-right
- x8 = fork(recolor, color, x7) - recolor that line with the cell's color
- x9 = merge all these
- x13 = canvas(mostcolor, double shape) = 6x6 filled with background
- x14 = paint(x13, x9)

So each non-background cell shoots a diagonal line down-right. Since shoot is connect from start to start+(42,42), it draws the full diagonal to the boundary (clipped by paint to 6x6).

Wait, connect from start to start+42 direction... it goes to (i+42, j+42), and the line is clipped at grid boundary by paint (0<=i<h, 0<=j<w). So it fills from (i,j) to boundary.

But note: the input is copied into upper-left 3x3 because those cells are at positions within 6x6 and are painted as their own color (each cell in the diagonal line includes itself). Actually yes, each non-background cell's shoot includes the start point.
